description: This file defines API routes for managing KYC (Know Your Customer) cases using FastAPI. It includes functions to create, list, and update KYC cases, handling file uploads, database interactions, and security dependencies.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class used to define API routes.

classes.name: KYCCase
classes.description: KYC case model representing a customer's KYC information.

classes.name: KYCStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible statuses of a KYC case.

classes.name: KYCOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting KYC case data to clients.

classes.name: KYCUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating KYC case information.

methods.name: Optional[str] _save_upload(file: Optional[UploadFile], subdir: str)
methods.description: Saves uploaded files to storage directory and returns their file path.

methods.name: create_kyc_case( full_name: str = Form(...), document_type: str = Form(...), document_number: str = Form(...), notes: Optional[str] = Form(None), document_file: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None), selfie_file: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new KYC case with optional document and selfie uploads.

methods.name: list_my_kyc_cases(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of KYC cases submitted by the current user.

methods.name: list_all_kyc_cases(db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])))
methods.description: Retrieves all KYC cases, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: update_kyc_case(case_id: int, body: KYCUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), admin: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])))
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of a specific KYC case, restricted to admin users.
